text:
Aisha: CloudHarbor reached out asking for a "co-sell sandpit" — lightweight shared tenant for a joint POC + a one-page runbook (provisioning, entitlements, SSO checklist, outbound IPs, and simple pilot pricing). They want it before their procurement review next week.
cloudharbor-contact: Ideally wed like dev access that behaves like Hosted, short-lived embed tokens for engineers, and a basic SSO test.
Diego: We can spin a sandpit tenant that mirrors Hosted behavior. No production keys. Offer scoped API keys + ephemeral tokens for embed/generate.
Marta: Security: we need the completed security questionnaire. Note: KMS/HSM only available on Private; Hosted sandpits get encrypted-at-rest + RBAC + audit logs. I'll draft canned answers.
Aisha: SAML checklist we should send them?
Diego: Minimal SAML checklist: EntityID, IdP metadata XML, assertionConsumerService (ACS) URL, public cert (PEM), NameID format, and a test user with email claim. Example snippet to request: ``<EntityDescriptor entityID=\"https://idp.cloudharbor.example\">...metadata...</EntityDescriptor>``. Also ask whether they want deprovisioning/SCIM (note: SCIM enabled for Dedicated only).
Marta: Entitlement template: propose three scopes - partner-dev (embed:write, generate:limited), metrics-read, logs-read. No billing permissions. I'll upload template to the shared drive and link in the runbook.
eng-bot: infra: requested NAT allocation for sandpit (req=88422). ETA ~90m. Will post outbound IPs here.
Diego: Short-lived token example: ``POST /admin/partners/{id}/tokens`` body: ``{"ttl":1800,"scopes":["embed:write","generate:limited"]}``. Tokens expire automatically and are logged.
Aisha: Pricing ask: what numbers do we give procurement for Hosted pilot vs short Dedicated eval? Keep it simple.
Marta: Standard Hosted pilot: 100k generation tokens + 3k embed units (pilot credits, no charge). Dedicated eval: depends on GPU; ballpark for 1xA10-equivalent pool ~ $10k/week (incl infra & basic support). I'll confirm exact quote with finance.
eng-bot: NAT ready. Outbound IPs: [18.204.55.60, 18.204.55.61]. Sandpit provisioning started (tenant=cloudharbor-sandpit-09, req=88422).
cloudharbor-contact: We'll send IdP metadata and primary technical contact by EOD. Also confirm pilot timeline: 3 weeks preferred.
Aisha: Plan: Ill assemble the one-pager (provision steps, entitlement template link, SAML checklist, outbound IPs, token example, pilot credits and Dedicated ballpark). Target to send tomorrow AM and schedule a demo once IdP metadata arrives. cc security & solutions-eng.
Marta: Uploaded: CH_entitlement_template_v3.docx and CH_security_answers_v1.pdf. I'll start the questionnaire answers now and finish once they send any requested SOC2 artifacts.
Diego: Once IdP metadata + test user come in I can enable SAML in test mode. Ops will rotate scoped tokens after the sandpit is decommissioned.
Aisha: Thanks all. If CloudHarbor posts the metadata here well try to get SAML test enabled before the demo. :thumbsup:
